lede: The one meeting worth circling on your calendar this week is Telluride's rescheduled Planning and Zoning Commission session on November 2, where a minor subdivision at 510 W Columbia Avenue goes before the chair — a lot-line vacation and merger that affects the Historic District, so it's worth knowing about. Beyond that, the government calendar is pretty quiet, with work sessions and unposted agendas filling most of the slots. On the community side, Halloween takes over the valley from Friday through Saturday, with the parade, open house at the fire station, and the TMHS and Telluride Theatre production of Young Frankenstein all on deck.

notable.stake: P&Z votes on lot-line vacation and merger in the Historic District.
